institution.name: Samudra Raya General Insurance
institution.legal_name: PT Samudra Raya General Insurance Tbk
institution.summary: Mid-size Indonesian general insurer: motor, property and engineering, marine cargo and hull, group health and personal accident, with a sharia (takaful-style) unit; sells through agents, brokers, motor dealers and banks, and buys reinsurance in Jakarta, Singapore and Europe.
